The selected campaign domain does not alter silent-lead recirculation, follow-up export, or campaign-cleanup behavior.
The domain purchase does not change the requirement to keep the existing MeetAlfred integration connected.
The domain purchase does not change which communication channels must be visible in HubSpot lead records.
The source decision concerns campaign-domain provisioning and does not change Apollo enrichment data or enrichment mode.
The campaign-domain purchase does not resume or modify the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization requirement.
The source message does not change the requirement to create and configure the Zapier account.
The domain purchase does not resolve or modify how existing CRM records should be indicated.
